facts.text: Through the Year-Round Campus program, students can complete a bachelor's degree in less than three years or a bachelor's and master's in four years.

sources.title: Year-Round Campus | University of Mary in Bismarck, ND
sources.quote: Through the University of Mary's one-of-a-kind Year-Round Campus program, you can earn your bachelor's degree in less than three years, your bachelor's and master's in four, or your bachelor's and doctorate in just six

facts.text: Year-Round Campus students take a full semester of classes each summer at the prior academic year's tuition rate.

sources.title: Year-Round Campus | University of Mary in Bismarck, ND
sources.quote: Each summer, you'll take a full semester of classes at the prior academic year's tuition rate. Over three years, you'll save thousands.
